snippet.title: Rave Heart+ - Special Edition Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
In celebration of Rave Heart's official release date anniversary (August 29), we bring you a teaser trailer of the upcoming Rave Heart+, a special edition of the game! You'll find new arts for dialogue portraits, battle sprites, battle VAs, and even a new character! Stay tuned for more!

Music used:
Rave Heart+ OST - Begin Warpdrive

Rave Heart on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375880/Rave_Heart/

More info on Rave Heart:
https://starmage.itch.io/rave-heart​
